Unpopular opinion: Ocarina of Time has aged badly.

Navi interrupts you every few minutes with advice you never asked for. The Water Temple is mostly menu diving for Iron Boots, not real puzzle solving. A masterpiece in 1998. Played fresh today, it feels slow and empty. Agree?
